quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards! They can also hover in place by flapping their wings in a figure-eight pattern up to 80 times per second. Their hearts beat up to 1,200 times per minute while flying.

short_read.title: The Secret Lives of Harbor Seals in the Pacific Northwest
short_read.teaser: Harbor seals are year-round residents of the Strait of Juan de Fuca, and they're more clever than you might think. Learn about their amazing diving abilities and how mothers recognize their pups by voice alone.

medium_read.title: The Joy of Growing Dahlias: A Gardener's Delight
medium_read.teaser: Dahlias bloom from midsummer through fall, bringing spectacular color when many other flowers are fading. This guide covers everything from choosing varieties to creating stunning bouquets from your own garden.

long_read.title: The Danube: Europe's Grand Highway of Culture
long_read.teaser: The Danube River flows through ten countries, connecting countless cultures and histories along its 1,770-mile journey. This beautiful exploration traces the river from Germany's Black Forest through Hungary's heartland to the Black Sea.

port_angeles.title: Black-Tailed Deer in Olympic National Park
port_angeles.description: August is a wonderful time to spot Columbian black-tailed deer in the forests and meadows around Port Angeles. These graceful animals are most active during dawn and dusk, and you might see fawns still staying close to their mothers. The Hurricane Ridge area often offers excellent viewing opportunities.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart can beat up to ___ times per minute while flying.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right! Isn't it amazing how such a tiny bird has such a powerful heart?
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 1,200 beats per minute — that's incredibly fast!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: The answer is 1,200 beats per minute! That's about 20 times faster than a human heart at rest.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: Hummingbirds have the fastest metabolism of all animals. To fuel their high-energy lifestyle, they must eat approximately every 10-15 minutes and visit hundreds of flowers each day.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! Pillangó is such a beautiful word for such a beautiful creature!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is 'pillangó'! Madár means bird, virág means flower, and szitakötő means dragonfly.
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: The Hungarian word 'pillangó' is thought to come from 'pillanni' (to flutter) combined with a suffix. Hungary is home to over 200 species of butterflies, including the beautiful Swallowtail.

puzzle_3.question: What did Olympic National Park become famous for protecting in 1938?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Perfect! The temperate rainforests of Olympic National Park are among the finest in the world, with some trees over 1,000 years old!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: The answer is old-growth rainforests! Olympic National Park protects some of the last remaining temperate rainforests in North America, right in your backyard.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Olympic National Park's Hoh Rain Forest receives 12-14 feet of rain annually, creating a magical world of moss-draped maples and massive Sitka spruce trees. It's one of the wettest places in the continental United States.

game.title: Bubble Shooter
game.description: A relaxing bubble puzzle game — aim and pop matching colored bubbles. Easy to pick up, fun to play!
